sentences.en: He walks with an awkward gait because of an injury.
sentences.zh: 由于受伤，他走路姿势很别扭。

sentences.en: Socially awkward people have a harder time finding romantic partners.
sentences.zh: 社交能力差的人更难找到恋爱对象。

sentences.en: At first the trainees were awkward in his company.
sentences.zh: 起初学员们在他面前显得有些尴尬。

phrases.zh: 社交笨拙的；不擅长交际的

senses.zh: （处理问题）缺乏手段和智谋的
